description: One PDF from a set of images, one per page: scans, photos of documents, screenshots, slides. Pages sized to A4 or Letter with margins, or exactly to each image; phone photos are turned upright. Price: $0.01 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Document tools: Work with PDFs and scans: read the text out of a PDF with page numbers and metadata, recognize the text in a scan, photo or screenshot, merge PDFs, take or reorder pages, split into parts, and turn images into a PDF..
